title: KernelLake Query Metrics (OTel)
description: Adapted from benchmarks/aws/monitoring/grafana/dashboards/kernellake-query-metrics.json for this single-instance local stack (no multi-host job-label regex needed). src/observability/query_tracing_otel.cpp emits kernellake.query.duration_seconds (a histogram of QueryResult::elapsed_wall_seconds, one sample per completed query) -- the OTel Collector's Prometheus exporter renders it as kernellake_query_duration_seconds_bucket/_sum/_count.

panels.title: Query latency heatmap (full distribution, from histogram buckets)
panels.description: Requires src/observability/internal.hpp's add_query_duration_histogram_view() (explicit seconds-scale bucket boundaries: 0.001..120) -- without it, every real query's sub-few-second latency collapses into the OTel SDK's own default first bucket (<=5s) and this heatmap (like the p50/p95/p99 panel above) is a single flat band, not a real distribution. Confirmed for real against this stack before/after that fix.
